name: What information does a contractor need before installing a bathtub?

mainEntity.name: What information does a contractor need before installing a bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you should expect to share the tub dimensions, bathroom layout, plumbing location, and whether you want a standard, soaking, or walk-in tub. Photos of the space help, but an in-home measurement is still the best way to confirm fit. In older homes around Denver and nearby suburbs, hidden plumbing or framing issues can change the scope after inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: You’ll need tub size, bathroom layout, plumbing details, and your preferred tub type. Photos help, but an in-home measurement gives the most accurate fit and pricing.
